text:
Alice: Heads-up — urgent hotfix for embed-service (v2.1.3) causing 503s in eu-west1. Planning fast cutover in ~10m; need expedited approvals.
Bob: Any ETA on root cause?
Alice: Repro'ed locally in staging — a memory regression in the quant attention kernel after the last runtime tweak. Patch is a config flip + rebuilt image. Minimal change.
Carol: Can we get release note + rollback plan before approving?
Alice: Release note: "Revert quant-kernel-opt to safe-path; addresses 503s under high seq-length workloads." Rollback: pin image back to v2.1.2 and scale new pods to 0; DB unaffected.
deploy-bot: deploybot: release job rls_1732102468 created by alice — requires approvals: eng-owner, oncall, infra. Starting staging canary in 2m.
oncall-ops: I'm oncall, will run quick canary smoke; hold for results.
Dave: Infra reviewed patch diff; LGTM as long as we have fallback pin and no config drift.
Alice: Fallback image pinned and healthcheck script updated. Command to rollback if needed:
```
kubectl set image deploy/embed embed=redwood/embed:v2.1.2 -n prod-eu1
kubectl rollout status deploy/embed -n prod-eu1
```
Carol: Approve :thumbsup: 
Bob: Product approve — customers are impacted, need swift fix. :shipit: 
oncall-ops: Staging canary smoke: 0 errors, latency within baseline. Approve to proceed to eu-west1 canary 10%.
deploy-bot: deploybot: approvals collected (alice, carol, oncall-ops, dave). Initiating rollout: prod-eu1 canary -> 10% traffic.
Alice: Monitoring live metrics. Threshold: if 503-rate > 0.5% or p95 latency +20% we stop.
sre-bot: alert: embed-service prod-eu1 503-rate = 0.6% at +3m; circuit-breaker triggered, holding further rollout.
Bob: Seeing the alert — should we cut traffic and rollback immediately?
Alice: Holding the rollout and invoking rollback plan now to minimize user impact.
deploy-bot: deploybot: rolling back rls_1732102468 — pinning to redwood/embed:v2.1.2, scaling new pods to 0. Rolling back traffic to safe image.
Carol: Nice quick coordination. Please open postmortem and include timeline + canary thresholds.
Alice: Will draft postmortem and add action item: add an automated perf regression test for seq-length distributions. Expedited approvals helped us act fast. :clap:
